200.description: Authorization decision (upstream TRQP authorization response plus the optional Verana breadcrumb).

message.description: Present only on session-scoped denials (e.g. `session not found`).

verana.description: Verana-specific breadcrumb for the grounding Participant row. Omitted when no Participant matched.

400.description: Malformed request (invalid action, resource grammar, or context.time).
